name: (Ghast) Stench
text:
10 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a Fortitude save save or become Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure).

While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Effect: Stench
